title: agent_image_upload output
description: Upload an agent's image ahead of its card (`ekl agent init` and `sync`, from a file on the publisher's machine): checked as check 3 checks an agent image, kept, and its network address returned for `agent.logo`.

url.description: The network's copy, /media/<sha256>.<ext> at its own address: what agent.logo names. Check 3 takes it without a fetch.
